about_the_game:
"In Blind Trust, communication isn't optional — it's your only way to survive."

Blind Trust is a 2–5 player co-op platformer that puts your teamwork to the ultimate test. In every game, only one player can see, while the rest are completely blindfolded — forced to rely entirely on the leader’s guidance to navigate deadly traps, precision jumps, and chaotic platforming challenges.

Work together using only voice, timing, and trust — but be warned: if any player falls, the entire team fails.
And when that happens, roles shift — someone new becomes the leader, and the challenge begins again from a new perspective.

Whether you're playing with friends or brave strangers, Blind Trust delivers a chaotic, emotional, and unforgettable experience where communication is survival, and every mistake changes everything.

  • 🎮 2–5 Player Online Co-Op
    A uniquely social experience focused on teamwork, trust, and live voice coordination.

  • 👁️ Only One Player Can See
    All other players are blindfolded — they must navigate purely by listening and reacting.

  • 💀 One Falls, All Fall
    If even one player fails, the entire group resets — and the leader role rotates.

  • 🔄 Dynamic Role Swapping
    Each death changes who leads, offering fresh perspectives and unpredictable chaos.

  • 🧩 Challenging Platforming Puzzles
    Navigate tight jumps, moving traps, and fragile terrain — all without seeing it.

  • 😂 Equal Parts Hilarious and Intense
    Expect total breakdowns, amazing comebacks, and lots of shouting.

  • 💬 Made for Friends, Couples, and Streamers
    Blind Trust is the perfect recipe for shared chaos, content gold, and unforgettable co-op sessions.

One leader. Many followers. One mistake — and it all resets.

Can your group survive ?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 8/10/11 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600@ 3.1 GHz or AMD R5 1600X @ 3.5 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 10 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • VR Support: Doesn't support VR
  • Additional Notes: A high-speed internet connection and a good connection between players are required to play. As this is only a multiplayer game.
